test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The amount obtained by investing a sum of Rs. 15,000 at 8% p.a. in a certain time is Rs. 17,496, interest compounded annually. What will be the amount (in Rs.) of the same sum at 15% p.a. for the same time, interest compounded 8-monthly?
solution:
Given:

The amount obtained by investing a sum of Rs. 15,000 at 8% p.a. in a certain time is Rs. 17,496, interest compounded annually. 

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the money be invested for N years.

According to the question,

15000(1 + 8/100)N = 17496

⇒ 1.08N = 17496/15000

⇒ 1.08N = 1.1664

⇒ 1.08N = 1.082

⇒ N = 2

2 years = 24 months

When interest compounded 8-monthly, N = 24/8 = 3

When interest compounded 8-monthly, rate of interest = 15 × 8/12 = 10%

Now, the amount will be

⇒ 15000(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ Rs. 19965

**∴ The amount of the same sum at 15% p.a. for the same time, interest compounded 8-monthly will become Rs. 19,965.**
